remarks: 104 Comstock Hill Ave is tucked away in the Silvermine area of Norwalk. If you're looking for peace & quiet this is certainly the place for you. Right next to what used to be a strawberry farm. One of the very few homes/cabins on this estate. ALL UTILITIES ARE INCLUDED IN PRICE! Updated cabin/cottage vibe including 1 spacious bedroom, 1 full bathroom, 1 half bath, living room, dining area/office & kitchen. Interior access to basement for storage & laundry. Large private yard perfect for grilling & entertaining. Plenty of parking in the driveway/lot for visitors. High Ceilings, hardwood floors, plenty of windows & cabinets/closets for comfort. Minutes from New Canaan & South Wilton. Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references.
